clause: Generative cloud filter rows (OPTIONAL, cloud adapter) [STU-FX-033,STU-FX-034]

scope.summary: OPTIONAL cloud-adapter generative rows as StudioLiveFilter entries (provider + credits; adapter-backed or omitted, not local parity): Generative Fill / Expand (text-prompted fill + canvas expansion), Generative Background Replace (prompted background replacement/generation), Generative Upscale / Harmonize (generative upscaling + composite harmonization). Output lands as non-destructive entry or new masked layer selectable by operator/model, never overwriting source; EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE when no adapter; provider calls headless/quiet (bounded, observable, attributable). MARK optional.
acceptance_criteria: Generative Fill/Expand, Generative Background Replace, Generative Upscale/Harmonize; optional cloud adapter; non-destructive landing; quiet
proof_targets: cloud-generative optional-lane registration + non-destructive landing + quiet test
expected_tests: test: cloud generative rows registered as optional adapter-backed effect_kind; EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE without adapter
test: output lands non-destructive (current/new/masked/new-document), never overwrites source; cloud call headless/quiet + attributable

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Cloud generative rows dropped; source-overwriting or noisy provider calls.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
